title: Spec Main Shape Gate fails every objectui PR since objectstack#22883 retired the `flow-template` ledger role; `flow-node-refs.ts:145` still compares against it
body:
Filing class: **① a shared-infrastructure red that blocks landing**. `Spec Main Shape Gate` now fails on every objectui pull request, and will fail every merge group, at one line in a file that no open pull request touches. This card is the one anchor for that failing check (landing-operations B, main-red rule ②: one failing check, one card, first filer wins). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`), which found it on PR objectui#12167.

## The reading

- **Red:** PR objectui#12167 at head `e167808`, check run `114613477132` (workflow run `38187685698`, created 2026-10-12T00:21Z).
  - One diagnostic, reported by both `type-check` and `build` in `packages/app-shell`.
  - The file and line: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-node-refs.ts:145`.
  - The error: TS2367 "This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '"value"' and '"flow-template"' have no overlap. — compiled against @objectstack/spec built from objectstack-ai/objectstack@9963322fe8b6".
- **Green on the same gate:** the merge group of PR objectui#12166 (run `38182517930`, created 2026-10-11T22:58Z), which landed as `main` `d2500d8`.
- **What changed in between:** objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #22883 merged at 23:06Z as `9fdb12752c`. It is stage S3 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 pass 4.
  - It moves the `loop.collection` and `map.collection` rows of `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` from role `flow-template` to `value`.
  - It drops `flow-template` from `FlowNodeExpressionRole`, which leaves `'predicate' | 'value'`.
- **The line on objectui `main`**, inside `slotsForType`, last changed in `e4c0b54`:
  `else if (entry.role === 'flow-template') slots.template.push(at);`
- **Why S3's own reading missed it.** That pull request's objectui reading names the designer sites and one test, and says the pinned console still builds. That holds at the pin. This line goes red only against spec `main`.
- **Other PRs:** PR objectui#12168 is also open, and its gate run is still in progress. Nothing in its diff touches this file.

## The fix

This card covers only objectui's compile side of S3:
- `slotsForType` compiles against both the installed spec, which still has `flow-template`, and spec `main`, which does not.
- Its behaviour at the pin stays the same.

Out of scope: the designer's two `collection` fields, `json-schema-to-fields.ts:255`, and the `FlowNodeInspector.loopItemVariable-9340` fixtures. objectui#12101 carries those (comment `6114405575`), and it stays on hold until an installable spec carries S3.

**Acting reader:** the `domain:ui` seat 1 claims this card under the lane's stanch exception (a `Spec Main Shape Gate` red on main or in the queue is claimed at once) and dispatches it. See the claim.

## Dedupe

- **objectui issues** created since 2026-10-11T20:00Z (REST list). Titles matched for `Spec Main Shape`, `flow-template`, `22883` and `flow-node-refs`: 0 hits on this check.
  - Control: the same list returns objectui#12169 and objectui#12163.
  - The nearest card is objectui#12101, the designer half of #19939 (`pm:on-hold`). Its S3 comment does not name `flow-node-refs.ts`.
- **objectstack issues and PRs** created since 2026-10-11T22:30Z (8 items). Titles matched for `Shape`, `flow-template`, `objectui`, `19939` and `collection`: 0 hits on this subject (2 false matches on "shape").
- **Open objectui PRs** whose file list contains `flow-node-refs`: 0.
